title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Everfield: Senior Data Engineer The Company Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies in order for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth. Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries who provide mission-critical applications, service, and support to their clients. Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia. The Position As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to: Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.) Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools Further developing Lakehouse Lumen , our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality. The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL . For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving. This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area. Responsibilities Adhere to the DevOps methodology by: Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer and Team Lead to plan and prioritize tasks. Develop data pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics, along with data ingestion and process scripts using PySpark and Pandas, while managing version control through Git. Improve and extend the MCP server that provides data to Claude. Create unit tests, test your own work and review work of colleagues (via Pull Requests), to ensure quality control. Extend the Lakehouse DevKit to support and accelerate agentic development workflows. Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines to facilitate smooth releases to end users. Monitor the data platform (including data pipelines, ingestion/processing jobs, and alerts), while continuously improving logging and monitoring practices. Ideal Candidate Profile Hard Skills Required: 3+ year of experience as Data Engineer , and 5+ years of professional experience within Data or related fields. Expert in PySpark and Pandas for data processing. Experience with Databricks for advanced analytics. Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling (especially star schema). Familiarity with financial systems (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with CRM systems and customer data . Nice to have: Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills) Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI for data visualization. Experience deploying Azure resources like Azure Container Apps . Soft Skills Independent Worker : Ability to operate autonomously while contributing effectively to team goals. Business Acumen : Strong understanding of business and economic principles, with an ability to apply them in a data context. Analytical Mindset : Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Collaborative : Actively seeks alignment with team members and participates in planning sessions. Quality-Focused : Committed to reviewing both your own work and that of others to maintain high standards. Strategic Planner : Consider alternative solutions and refine features before implementation. Purpose-Driven : Demonstrates a deep understanding of tasks, ensuring they align with business objectives. What’s in it for you? Grow your career in a fast-paced and growing organization. Enable growth by building a robust and scalable data platform. Working with the latest Data Engineering & Data Modeling technologies. Long term career opportunities. Working from home for up to 4 days per week. Flexible work environment with offices around Europe (Netherlands, UK, Spain, France, Poland, Germany). Continue the Conversation Interested?
